description: I5: Confused-deputy check. Use a user token as subject_token but authenticate the exchange request as a different client (M2M). Ensure the exchanged token does not grant user identity/permissions under the M2M client context.

oracle_checks.violation_description: M2M client successfully exchanged a user subject_token into a token/session bound to the same user identity, indicating confused-deputy authorization binding failure in token exchange.
